concepts.title: 1. Quality-Control Probability
concepts.subtitle: Good versus defective items
concepts.summary: For a mixed lot, all items form the sample space. The event count is the number of good or defective items requested.
concepts.trap: Using only the favorable category as the denominator.

concepts.title: 2. Calendar and Birthday Probability
concepts.subtitle: Use weekday cases and extra days
concepts.summary: A non-leap year has 365 days and one extra day after 52 complete weeks; a leap year has 366 days and two extra days. Birthday weekday comparisons use the seven equally likely weekdays.

points.text: For two independent weekday choices, the same-day probability is $1/7$.

concepts.trap: Treating 2 extra days in a leap year as one fixed pair of weekdays.

concepts.title: 3. Spinners and Target Areas
concepts.subtitle: Count equal sectors or compare areas
concepts.summary: For equal spinner sectors, probability is favorable sectors over total sectors. For uniform geometric hits, probability is target area divided by total region area.
concepts.trap: Using perimeter or diameter instead of area in a target-area problem.

concepts.title: 4. Number Cards and Mathematical Criteria
concepts.subtitle: Translate a condition into a count
concepts.summary: For consecutive number cards, every integer in the range is equally likely. Count numbers meeting the criterion—such as squares, primes, or divisibility—before forming the probability.

points.text: Count the criterion set $E$ before forming $P(E)=n(E)/n(S)$.

concepts.trap: Forgetting endpoints or miscounting mathematical criteria.

schema_notes.strict_options_rule: Every strategy option and option_details text combines a concise instruction with actual counts, subsets, calculations, or values wrapped in single dollar signs.
schema_notes.latex_compliance: All equations, substitutions, calculations, and rubrics use multiline aligned LaTeX with at most one equals sign per line.
schema_notes.guided_calculation_compliance: Every step has exactly two vertically stacked outputs; placeholders are strictly Enter value; prompts and labels do not leak answers.
schema_notes.pool_compliance: Each of the four typologies contains exactly 12 unique questions: 4 Easy, 4 Medium, 4 Hard.
schema_notes.svg_rule: Zero SVG topic: diagram_svg is omitted from every question object.
schema_notes.topic_isolation: This topic is restricted to the four specified applied-probability typologies: quality-control lots, calendar/birthday cases, spinners/target areas, and consecutive number cards. No downstream dice/coin compound-event methods are introduced.
